name: vibebook-plugin
description: Vibebook Claude Code plugin — digest sessions into chronicles + topics, recall past notes before work. Standalone, no extra CLI required. For cross-device sync, see the vibebook npm CLI (separate package).

plugins.name: vibebook
plugins.description: Run /vibebook to digest your sessions into chronicle + topic and distill durable typed memory. Run /vibebook-context at the start of work so a new session begins already familiar with the project (architecture, setup, gotchas, rules). Run /vibebook-recall to dig into past chronicles.
